Name: Better Garden Pots
Author: CatCattyCat
Description:
[size=6]Better Garden Pots

[/size][size=3]This mod makes garden pots way better. It:[/size]
[list]
[*]Makes bee houses notice flowers in garden pots, so they'll produce honey of that flower type.
[*]Makes sprinklers water crops in garden pots. Compatible with better sprinklers and simple sprinklers!
[*]Harvests mature crops when garden pots break, so if you break one by accident you don't lose your crop!
[*]Allows you to plant ancient seeds in garden pots (disabled by default).
[*]Allows you to grow crops in garden pots in any season outside as well as inside (disabled by default).
[/list]
Every option is configurable by editing the config.json file.

[size=4][b]**Some features like watering garden pots with sprinklers and bee houses noticing garden pots may only work if the host has the mod installed in multiplayer, but other players can have it installed without a problem.**[/b][/size]

Requires SMAPI by Pathoschild.
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/users/44734342?tab=user+files][size=5]Check out my other mods by clicking here![/size][/url]

Downloads.Description: Place in your Stardew Valley/Mods folder to install. Requires SMAPI 2.9+.
